title: StorageLocation
description: A generic, extensible storage location entity that records where files are stored. It does not grant access, and validation does not connect to storage.

storage_id.description: Unique identifier for the storage location.

system.description: Type of storage system as a free-form token. Common values include filesystem, s3, azure, gcs, and nfs; these are examples, not a closed list.

path.description: Locator string for the storage location: a path, URI, or bucket/container reference. This schema does not define one locator syntax, so the string is not always a URI.

connection_details.description: Opaque, implementation-defined connection data. It must not be used as authority to connect. It should not hold secrets; consumers must protect any legacy secrets it contains.

description.description: Human-readable description of the storage location.

schema_version.description: Version of the storage location schema used to create this record. Follows semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0.0'). Optional but recommended for evolution and compatibility checks.

extensions.description: Extension point for custom fields or plugin data. Keys SHOULD be prefixed with 'x_' or 'custom_' to avoid collision with future standard fields.
